description: This is a Java JUnit test class for unit testing the VisitValidator component in the OpenMRS core project. It covers validation logic for the Visit entity, including date consistency, overlapping visits, and handling of special cases such as voided visits and birthdate constraints.

classes.name: VisitValidatorTest
classes.description: JUnit test class for testing various validation scenarios of the Visit object within the OpenMRS core's validation framework.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitThatHasTheRightNumberOfAttributeOccurrences
methods.description: Tests that a visit with the correct number of attributes passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitIfItHasFewerThanMinOccursOfAnAttribute
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if a visit has fewer attributes than the minimum required.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitIfItHasMoreThanMaxOccursOfAnAttribute
methods.description: Ensures validation fails if a visit has more attributes than the maximum allowed.

methods.name: makeVisit
methods.description: Helper method to create a new Visit instance with default attributes for testing.

methods.name: makeVisit
methods.description: Creates a Visit with a specified patient ID.

methods.name: makeAttribute
methods.description: Creates a VisitAttribute with a given typed value.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfPatientIsNotSet
methods.description: Test that validation fails if the patient is not assigned to the visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfStartDatetimeIsNotSet
methods.description: Test that validation fails if start datetime is missing.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfVisitTypeIsNotSet
methods.description: Test that validation fails if visit type is missing.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheEndDatetimeIsBeforeTheStartDatetime
methods.description: Test that validation catches if stop datetime is before start datetime.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheStartDatetimeIsAfterAnyEncounter
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when start date is after an encounter's date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfTheStopDatetimeIsBeforeAnyEncounter
methods.description: Ensures validation fails when stop date is before an encounter's date.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailIfAnAttributeIsBad
methods.description: Disabled test for malformed attributes, related to Hibernate constraints.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsBeforeAndEndsAfterAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Tests overlapping visit rejection when a new visit encapsulates an existing one.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsBeforeAndEndsDuringAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Tests overlap rejection when a new visit starts before and ends during an existing visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsDuringAndEndsAfterAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Overlap rejection when a new visit starts during and ends after an existing one.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsAndEndsDuringAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Overlap rejection when a new visit is entirely within an existing visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatStartsAtTheSameTimeAsAnExistingVisit
methods.description: Rejects if a new visit starts at the same time as an existing visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectAVisitThatEndsAtTheSameTimeAsAnExistingEvent
methods.description: Rejects if a new visit ends at the same time as an existing visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectOverlappingNewActiveVisit
methods.description: Rejects overlapping active visits when the new visit has no end date.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectOverlappingActiveVisits
methods.description: Rejects when a new active visit overlaps with an existing active visit.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotRejectOnVisitOverlapDuringEndVisit
methods.description: Should pass validation when updating an active visit to close without overlaps.

methods.name: validate_shouldRejectOnVisitOverlapDuringEndVisitWithStartDateUpdated
methods.description: Should reject if overlap occurs when updating start and stop dates during end visit process.

methods.name: validate_shouldNotRejectOnVisitOverlapDuringUpdate
methods.description: Validates that updating an existing visit without overlaps passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitIfStartDateTimeIsEqualToStartDateTimeOfAnotherVoidedVisitOfTheSamePatient
methods.description: Allows same start date if the prior visit is voided and of the same patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitIfStartDateTimeFallsIntoAnotherVoidedVisitOfTheSamePatient
methods.description: Allows start date within a voided visit of the same patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitIfStopDateTimeFallsIntoAnotherVoidedVisitOfTheSamePatient
methods.description: Allows stop date within a voided visit of the same patient.

methods.name: validate_shouldAcceptAVisitIfItContainsAnotherVoidedVisitOfTheSamePatient
methods.description: Allows a visit that fully contains another voided visit of the same patient.

methods.name: patientHasVoidedVisit
methods.description: Helper to check if a patient has a specific voided visit based on start and stop timestamps.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfFieldLengthsAreCorrect
methods.description: Checks that visit with valid void reason passes validation.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfFieldLengthsAreNotCorrect
methods.description: Checks that overly long void reason causes validation to fail.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVisitDateBeforeBirthDate
methods.description: Validation rejects visits starting before patient's birth date.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfVisitDateOnBirthDate
methods.description: Allows visit starting exactly on the patient's birth date.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfVisitDateAfterBirthDate
methods.description: Allows visit starting after the patient's birth date.

methods.name: validate_shouldPassValidationIfVisitDateOnEstimatedBirthDatesGracePeriod
methods.description: Allows visit on estimated birth date within grace period.

methods.name: validate_shouldFailValidationIfVisitDateBeforeEstimatedBirthDatesMinimumOneYearGracePeriod
methods.description: Fails if visit date is too early before estimated birth date, beyond grace period.

methods.name: parseIsoDate
methods.description: Utility method to parse ISO date strings into Date objects.

methods.name: validateVisitOverlap
methods.description: Helper to validate visit potential overlaps based on start and end dates.
